payloads.text: {"satirical_angle":"Bureaucracy mistakes activity for progress.","headline":"A Committee Finds Another Committee","summary":"A tidy machine keeps moving while the answer waits outside the meeting room.","article":"The committee discovered that every emergency became tidier once it was filed twice. Its paperwork applauded itself and requested a smaller meeting about applause. Nobody solved anything, but every folder achieved a sense of purpose. A fictional spokesperson for forms declined to comment because the comment needed another form. By sunset, the institution had produced a timetable for deciding when to begin deciding. It was a triumph of motion, provided nobody confused motion with arrival. The queue wore a tie, the minutes applauded politely, and the stapler was promoted to deputy strategy officer."}
